title: rahimahgilani/pdf-chatbox
summary: 该PDF Chatbot利用AI技术，允许用户通过自然语言查询上传文档并提问。基于RAG探索，结合ChromaDB和FAISS向量数据库，以及LangChain的LLM工作流程，实现上下文感知的文档理解。，基于模型推理的架构
description: An AI-powered PDF Chatbot that allows users to upload documents and ask questions through natural language queries. Built to explore Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), vector databases (ChromaDB & FAISS), embeddings, and LangChain-based LLM workflows for context-aware document understanding.
